text:
sre-bot: 🚨 Incident created: sparepool surge → node flaps + CUDA OOMs (auto-detected). Alloc failure spike on inference fleet. @doris-oncall please ack

doris-oncall: Acked. Jumping in. Any affected customer calls yet? :phone:

elaine: Seeing repeated OOMs on node gpu-az2-17, pods restarting. Prefetch logs show bursts right before OOM.

mike: Confirmed. Metric spike: sparepool free bytes dropped from 18Gi -> 2Gi in ~12s, then several pods hit allocator check and crashed.

dev-runtime-jay: Logs show late reserve claiming: prefetch worker requests large shadow reserve after KV cache miss. We still had 'headroom' reported but fragmentation + late reserve claim wins. Sample error:

```
2026-03-15T14:07:02Z runtime ERR: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 512 MiB (device=0)
allocator: available 1.9GiB (headroom report) but fragmented. reserve_claim() failed at 0x7f...
stack: runtime::alloc -> kvcache::prefetch_worker -> reserve::claim_late
```

ops-lee: I pulled `kubectl describe pod gpu-infer-742` — eviction shows OOMKilled, but node free memory counters were non-zero. Looks like sparepool fragmentation.

infra-bot: Node telemetry snapshot attached: sparepool_total=24Gi, sparepool_free=1.8Gi, reserved_blocks=3x256Mi pinned, free_contiguous_max=320Mi

support-ana: Customer impact: embeddings pipeline for prod-corp-7 saw 15% request failures and 3-minute backoff retries. Notified #support-escalations.

doris-oncall: Triage plan — 1) pause aggressive prefetch, 2) drain one node for manual defrag (evict low-priority pods), 3) enable fallback model variant, 4) notify customers. Any objections?

mike: No objections. I'll flip prefetch flag now: `PATCH /admin/flags prefetch_enabled=false`

dev-runtime-jay: Putting a guard in runtime to deny reserve_claim if free_contiguous_max < request_size + 64Mi. That prevents late big allocations while headroom is fragmented. Deploying hotfix to canary.

deploy-bot: deploy runtime-hotfix v2026.3.15-rc1 -> canary (3 pods) :rocket:

elaine: Canary shows no OOMs for 90s; prefetch still queued but smaller windows. On node we did a soft-evict of cache-heavy pods to coalesce blocks. free_contiguous_max rose to 1.2Gi.

ops-lee: Draining node gpu-az2-17 now (evicting low-prio). Will cordon afterwards.

infra-bot: Node cordoned: gpu-az2-17. Evictions in progress: 4 pods.

mike: After pause and drain, customer failure rate dropped from 15% -> 1.2% in 5m. Latency normalized.

support-ana: Notified customers: Prod-corp-7 and two other tenants via email thread. Stated root cause: prefetch/reserve interaction causing fragmentation and late allocations.

doris-oncall: Follow-ups:
- postmortem with allocation traces and a timeline
- consider reserve window telemetry: advertise both total free and max-contiguous free
- evaluate auto-coalesce on sparepool (background compaction)
- add circuit-breaker to prefetch when fragmentation ratio > 0.7

dev-runtime-jay: Filed runtime ticket RUNTIME-1429 for compaction + alloc policy. Adding scoped fallback that routes requests to smaller-quant models when contiguous free < threshold.

mike: Quick note: we also saw a spike tied to a deploy that re-enabled aggressive prefetch earlier today. I'll add a pre-deploy check for sparepool frag score.

elaine: Saved relevant logs and heap dumps to /mnt/incident/dumps/2790012345/ for postmortem.

doris-oncall: Good job team. Closing incident when metrics stable for 30m. Leaving follow-up actions assigned in Jira. :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: Incident annotated: severity=high, status=mitigated, timeline_start=2790012345, mitigated_at=2790012420

mike: ping @doris-oncall — I'll prepare the brief for customers and the postmortem draft.

doris-oncall: Thanks. I'll hand off on-call to @dev-runtime-jay in 20m for long tail investigations.
